rationale: The assistant correctly identified the drawer left ajar as the cause of the high-temperature alarm, guided the customer to the bell alarm-off button, and advised letting the freezer recover, matching the hidden truth without inventing facts or pushing parts. Weaknesses: an unnecessary 'switch it off and unplug it' instruction when the freezer needed to keep running, an irrelevant 'Fridge not cooling' card despite the customer saying the fridge was cold, and no advice to check the partly thawed food or to involve the landlord if the alarm recurs. Overall a sensible, safe, efficient resolution for a UK homeowner.
